scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm lint:api && pnpm lint:data
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:data: cd tools/data-pipeline && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:data
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/backend/server && uv run mypy app tests
scripts.typecheck:data: cd tools/data-pipeline && uv run mypy src tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:client && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:data
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff format . && cd ../../../tools/data-pipeline && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../../../tools/data-pipeline && uv run ruff format --check .
